title: Mere Soch Pare Bhi, Kuch Hona Hain
excerpt: Ek samay tha jaha sab kuch naa paane ka bhay tha, ek aaj waqt hain jaha sab kuch hoke bhi jindgi lagti kamwaqt hain...
content:
Mere Soch Pare Bhi, Kuch Hona Hain

Ek samay tha jaha,
Sab kuch naa paane ka bhay tha

Ek aaj waqt hain, jaha sab kuch hoke bhi
Jindgi, lagti kamwaqt hain!!!

Kuch paya, toh kuch khoya hu
Kuch paya, toh kuch khoya hu
Dil jab jab na laga, tab tab roya hu.

Sapne dekhe bade udaan ke hain,
Par main toh yunhi soya hu.
Dil jab jab na laga, tab tab roya hu.

Pata hota agar, kuch paane ko, kuch khona hain!
Mere soch pare bhi, kuch hona hain.

Sambhaal ke rakhata uss pal ko, jo khaas the
Jab pata hota isko bhi, ek din khona hain.
Mere soch pare bhi, kuch hona hain.

title: Kuch Khayaal Aise Hain
excerpt: Kuch khayal aise hain jo meet nahi patein, kuch shaam aisi hain jo dhal nahi patein. Log toh charo taraf hain lekin fir sab me hum ghool meel nahi patein...
content:
Kuch Khayaal Aise Hain

Kuch khayal aise hain jo meet nahi patein
Kuch shaam aisi hain jo dhal nahi patein

Log toh charo taraf hain
Lekin fir sab me hum ghool meel nahi patein

Bahar bheed ka nazaraa hain toh
Under jhanka toh sukha kinaara hain

Kuch khayal aise hain jo meet nahi patein
Kuch shaam aisi hain jo dhal nahi patein

Kabhi aarzoo hoti hain apno ki,
Fir lagta sab thik ho jayegaa
Par ye toh waqat he batayega, 
Lagta hain ye zindgi yuhi, 
Tanha kat jayega

Sapne toh hazaar hain, 
Bahut he besoomar hain 
Sapno ko pana hain ya apno ko, 
Ye soch ke dil av bhi bekaraar hain

Anshu toh dil me aatein hain, 
Ankho ki aukaat kya hain
Sochata hu ro lu jee bhar ke,
Par itna v ye aashaan kahan hain

Kuch khayal aise hain jo meet nahi patein
Kuch shaam aisi hain jo dhal nahi patein

title: Dhool Aur Khamoshi
excerpt: Hum hawa ke wo columns hain jo yaadon ki frequency par vibrate hote hain. Seene ke andhere mein purane shehar ki aawazein qaid hain...
content:
Dhool Aur Khamoshi

Hum hawa ke wo columns hain jo yaadon ki frequency par vibrate hote hain.
Seene ke andhere mein purani imaarat ki acoustics chhupi hai, jaise khali corridors mein fluorescent battiyon ki dheemi si sarsarahat.

Hum aawazon mein baat karte hain — hansi ke wo pal jo drywall aur pardon ki narmi mein foran gayab ho jaate hain.
Hum dhoondhte hain ek aisa kona jahan koi shor na ho, ek bilkul saaf slate, jahan sirf apne saanson ki aawaz sunai de.

Lekin kaanon mein shehar ki dhool jam jaati hai, jaise ek purana filter, jo teekhe lafzon ko dheere-dheere gol kar deta hai... aur peeche chhod jaata hai sirf ek halka sa, warm aur meetha sukoon.

title: Sannate Ki Geometry
excerpt: Khamoshi aawaz ki gair-maujoodgi nahi hai; yeh toh lafzon ke beech ki deewar hai. Agar pause na ho, toh shayari bas shor ban jaati hai...
content:
Sannate Ki Geometry

Khamoshi aawaz ki gair-maujoodgi nahi hai; yeh toh lafzon ke beech ka wajood hai.

Stage par jab ek shayar do line bolne ke baad do second ke liye rukta hai, wahi do second mein audience ka dil dhadakta hai. Agar wo pause na ho, agar wo thehraav na ho, toh shayari bas ek tez shor ki train ban kar nikal jaati hai — kaan tak pahunchti hai, par rooh ko chhoo nahi paati.

Hum shehar mein shor se bachne ke liye headphones pehante hain, par dil ke andar ka shor kaise rokein? Shayad isiliye hum likhte hain — taaki jo cheez andar cheekh rahi hai, use kaagaz par thehraav mil sake.
